تصطحبوا (form VIII)

# تُصْطَحَبُوا (tuṣṭaḥabū) /tusˤ.tˤa.ħa.buː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَحَبَ (iṣṭaḥaba)
